_comment: Parts the power model distinguishes. A measurement whose quantity dependsOn a component records which one it was taken with, by id. Add a part here before measuring it. A card is identified by its model and speed class only: each run records the capacity and allocation unit of the card in the slot, so capacity is checked as a covariate instead of multiplying ids.

microphones.notes: The on-board analog path; measured by the analog suite rather than per part.
